propositions: The undeclared-paths gate refusal instructs authors to declare paths and retry, but the retry fails with stale-material because declaring paths changes the material basis hash
The close gate's remedy message omits that widening file_impact is a material plan change which invalidates the attestation and requires re-attestation
Widening file_impact retroactively broadens what an existing attestation claims to cover, since the signature scope is built from declared file_impact union the files the review cited
file_impact is a direct input to plan review at four sites (pass1.py, det_lint.py, det_invariants.py, det_gate_rules.py) so new paths can introduce new findings
The materiality test hashes the whole file_impact list, making any mutation equally different and preventing downstream distinction between additive and destructive changes
